# STAKED

> STAKED (staked.food) is a food-deals service in Baku, Azerbaijan. Customers pick a discounted offer from fast-food restaurants, pay from their STAKED balance, and receive a short pickup code. They type the code at the self-service kiosk in the restaurant to collect the order.

The site is available in Russian, English and Azerbaijani. Prices are in Azerbaijani manat (AZN).

## How it works

1. Choose an offer in the menu (burgers, sides, combos).
2. Top up the balance: transfer the amount using the details in the pinned message of the STAKED Telegram channel, then upload a screenshot of the receipt. An operator checks it and credits the balance.
3. Place the order. An operator confirms it and sends a pickup code, which appears under "My orders".
4. Enter the code at the restaurant's self-service kiosk and collect the food. The code is valid for a limited time.

## Links

- [Website](https://staked.food/): menu, balance top-up and orders
- [Telegram channel](https://t.me/stackdbaku): payment details and news
- [Support](https://t.me/sharkiff): questions about orders and payments

# STAKED (на русском)

> STAKED (staked.food) — сервис скидок на еду в Баку. Выберите предложение в меню, оплатите с баланса и получите короткий код. Введите его в автомате в ресторане и заберите заказ.

Пополнение: переведите сумму по реквизитам из закреплённого сообщения Telegram-канала @stackdbaku и прикрепите скриншот чека. Баланс пополнится после проверки оператором. Поддержка: @sharkiff.

# STAKED (Azərbaycan dilində)

> STAKED (staked.food) Bakıda yemək endirimləri xidmətidir. Menyudan təklif seçin, balansdan ödəyin və qısa kod alın. Kodu restoranın özünəxidmət terminalına daxil edin və sifarişi götürün.
